top_choice_rationale: Palladium-catalysed C-N cross-coupling by Buchwald and Hartwig is the one candidate whose mechanism is established by isolated intermediates and kinetics, whose ligand-design logic explains the move from curiosity to general method, and whose impact is measured over three decades of independent use. Attribution is the cleanest on the slate, and the 2010 C-C coupling prize does not cover the distinct amido reductive-elimination problem. Base editing (Liu) is a credible second part but is less mature, and the pairing in P001 adds an uneven part; the lipid nanoparticle trio has contested attribution and reads closer to formulation.
